name: Star Copper Corp.
summary: Star Copper Corp. specializes in the identification and preparation of mineral sites for extraction. The firm's efforts are concentrated on locating deposits of copper, gold, and molybdenum. Its most prominent venture is the Star project, an entirely owned property spanning roughly 6,829 hectares. This key asset is situated in Canada's British Columbia, specifically within the renowned Golden Triangle and Golden Horseshoe regions. Established in 2018, the company, whose main office is in Vancouver, Canada, was formerly recognized as Alpha Copper Corp. before officially changing its name to Star Copper Corp. in February 2025.
